reviews.text: Excellent service 10/10
Excellent services
Very caring
They speak rudely to you on the phone. They also make it clear they don't speak Spanish.
Excellent services
We love it here. Great vets and helpful staff <3
I love it and my dog loves it too..

I couldn't recommend this vet office more highly. Dr. Tsung and Dr.Turner in particular are particularly exceptional and truly care about both  health and  budget. Instead of piling on medical exams, she took a careful, step-by-step approach, ensuring we provided the best medical treatment without creating unnecessary financial stress. When a vet does this, it's a huge indication of their devotion and care to the animals that they are providing treatment for.

It is so bad, I want to give you a zero, but that's not possible, so I give you a one. I wish the clinic had been more transparent about pricing over the phone. When I called to schedule an appt, I was told that the cost would be dependent on my cat's weight. Based on this, I expected his size and age to be reflected in the price.

Instead, I brought my 9-month-old male cat, who weighs less than >5lbs and was presented with a $900 estimate for a routine neuter. Even though the neutering cost was a $306 fee, they charged separately for virtually every other component: $172.50 for anesthesia, $110 for bloodwork, $80 for a catheter, $81 for the exam, $73 for heart screening, $38 for collar, $40 for his medicine... i mean the list goes on and on.

It felt like a clear lack of transparency over the phone. If the clinic is going to charge separately for every thing and not include these fees within the feline-neutering costs, that should be stated over the phone as opposed to just saying that the cost is based on the cat's weight. In the end, we respectfully declined the procedure.

Don't be foolish by coming here for anything beyond emergency services, unless you want to be charged like you're on 5th Ave while sitting in Inwood. Almost $1,000 to neuter a 4lbs cat is criminal behavior.
Best place ever! Wonderful caring and professional staff. Customer 8 years  ❤️
I love this clinic and my baby likes it too!! He gets treated like family, I will not go anywhere else! 🩷
I take all my cats here and it’s the best! everyone is so kind and empathetic. i won’t go anywhere else!

Thank you for the five stars, Pat! We're glad your visit went well, and we're always here whenever you or your pet need us.

— Steve M., CVPM CVBL, Practice Manager

Thank you for the great rating, Lisa! It's good to know we're doing right by you and your pet. We appreciate you taking a moment to leave this, and we're here whenever you need us.

— Steve M., CVPM CVBL, Practice Manager
excellent service.  Quick and attentive.  knowledable

Thank you for the five stars, Katherine! A rating like this means a lot to the team, and we appreciate you taking a moment to leave it. We hope to see you and your pet again soon.

— Steve M., CVPM CVBL, Practice Manager

I came here for the first time for an emergency grooming and nail appointment because my dog Charlie really needed it badly. They were able to schedule us for the very next day, which I truly appreciated. His appointment was at 8:30 AM, and he was seen immediately. We were all done and out by 10:50 AM!

What really stood out to me was the communication. You receive text messages every step of the way, including updates and details about your dog, so you always know what’s going on. I really appreciated how informed and comfortable they made me feel throughout the entire process.

What a gem! The service was amazing, and Charlie came out happier than ever. 🐶❤️ I’m so happy I found this place and would truly recommend them to anyone looking for great grooming service. We’ll definitely be back!

Helped me get my dog her shots and medicine I needed for her ear infection.
Before complaining about pricing tell them you are on a budget first and they will go over pricing before performing anything.
I really enjoyed being my dog here. The vets were all friendly and focused on our comfort and not getting money from us but I think it's because I told them I need the prices before they do anything.

Genuinely I wish I brought my cat here before he passed away. Maybe getting a second opinion would have saved his life and they are so thoughtful/thorough here.

Excellent Vet Clinic and Grooming service. I highly recommend this clinic. I took my elderly dog there for two years and I still use them even after moving to another state. They are the best!! Love you guys at Inwood Clinic! Thank you for everything you have done for Collins:) You are the best!!
Good experience the lady at the front desk was very patient and helpful as well.

I continue to visit Inwood Vet because of the incredible attention and care that Rosie and Marisol give me and my pup every time we come in. They are truly the best!

If you’re looking for a doctor, I highly recommend Dr. Tsung. She is awesome, super detailed, thorough, and always makes sure to follow up with any additional information you may need after your visit. She's also great at returning phone calls!

Thank you, ladies, for always taking such great care of us! ❤️
They are amazing with my babies, very patient and their dedication to their work is evident.
Took care of my reactive dog and the person in charge of holding my dog down for examination was very patient and understanding. Overall great spot for dog care.

Do not take your pets here if you want quality care. I took my dog in. They insisted I pay for a ton of tests claiming it was critical and necessary, and then never even bothered to call with the results or check if she was ok. If it was so critical and necessary I spend a fortune in tests, then the least they could do was follow up. They are negligent and it felt like I was hustled and taken advantage of in a time of need.  They should be embarrassed with the way they do business. Just for the record, she was totally fine and none of the things they forced on me were necessary.

This place has all the red flags of a money mill that puts animal care in the backseat.
It was an overbooked and chaotic waiting room. I had a 1030am appointment and they were already running over 1 hour behind schedule. Cats and dogs and humans were on top of each other. It felt unsafe and stressful for the animals.
Vet technician kept confusing my two dogs while recording important information.
The vet did not hit a vein when drawing blood and sent a vial of fat cells off for over $400 in testing. I had to return 2 days later for a tech to take a proper blood sample. This was a sloppy oversight that put my dog under unnecessary additional stress.
I had to request the written clinical blood panel results multiple times. Rather than providing blood panel results in a professional and complete manner, they call and give a dramatic reading. First dog, everything is great, normal, fine then the grand finale - his urinalysis was SLIGHTLY diluted… we should really run additional test to be sure he doesn’t have kidney or liver disease. … This interpretation was wrong, They were chasing dollar signs wanting me to pay for more needless tests.
Second dog, everything is great, normal, fine then the grand finale - he has a barely detectable anomaly that’s probably nothing but we require you to do an ($800+) echocardiogram before we book a teeth cleaning…. They really are shamelessly obvious.
Their estimates are wildly inconsistent.Over the phone, ball-parked $1500-2500 for teeth cleaning/extractions.
4 days and several requests for a written quote later, I received an estimate of $800-$1700. I found this difference concerning so I emailed several questions.
Rather than an email response, I received a call from a woman who identified herself as the owner and a veterinarian. She stated that the written estimate was, as I suspected, too low. Cleanings do start at around $1500 and go up from there with extractions, meds etc.
Upon reflection, I’m sure my dog would have been returned with several unnecessary extractions had proceeded at Inwood. Instead, I ran to a different Veterinary practice where my dog needed ZERO extractions. The X-rays, cleaning, sealing and nail trim came to $780. The senior blood panel I paid for at Inwood also would have been over $150 less at the vet I went to next.
I understand a business has bills to pay but subjecting animals to unnecessary tests, procedures and sedations in the name of profit is unethical.
Inconsistent pricing is mercenary.
Overblown dramatic readings of test results to upsell unnecessary additional tests/procedures is exploitive.

Inwood animal clinic has a level of negligence that eventually led to my pet having to be Euthanized. Please know that they have zero oversight of the grooming services, while your animal gets groomed here, they supposedly aren’t responsible for what the groomers do, use, the cleanliness of the grooming as the grooming service is a separate entity. My Shih tzu got groomed here by someone who returned him to us with cuts all over his body, not razor burn, open wound cuts. One of these cuts then got infected severely and this infection spread to my dogs ears and skin barrier. We spent thousands taking him to the inwood vet and they kept prescribing different antibiotics every month, until one vet said “how do they know what bacteria/infection they are treating if no one has ran cultures?” The vet was questioning the stupidity of his own colleagues at this clinic. Long story short, due to these vets blinding prescribing rounds upon rounds of antibiotics to my otherwise healthy dog, he developed MRSP, an antibiotic resistant bacteria ALL over his body, ears, snout, neck. I made the choice to take him to a dermatologist elsewhere and she confirmed that the over prescription of antibiotics likely led to this. She tried to help us and gave him a human antibiotic, the strongest possible and he still didn’t heal. We had to put our dog to sleep because Inwood animal clinic is a money hungry, irresponsible, incompetent animal clinic. None of the vets communicate with each other, they don’t look at charts to understand history, and I know this because every time we went we got a different vet and they were asking us questions as if we had answers for them, instead of looking at my dogs charts or communicating with the vets that previously saw him to see the best course of action. This clinic is the only one within miles of this area and they know it and get away with their negligent and irresponsible practices. They should shut this place down, the groomer who did this to my dog is often refused by many customers, this was confirmed to me by one of the employees when they admitted that people reschedule groomings when they find out that groomer is the only groomer in for the day.
They take good care of their non-human patients.
Dr Tsung is exceptionally caring, knowledgeable and skilled, and she’s an expert at interacting with cats in a kind, respectful way.

Staff is super friendly and accommodating. Obvious they all know how to handle the pets with a lot of care and know what they’re doing. They work quickly and have a lot of staff available. They also didn't try to push any unnecessary scans tests or treatments my dog didn’t need in order to stack my bill like another clinic I went to tried to do. They treated what I came in for and also checked his general wellness. Their pricing is reasonable. They helped my dog feel a lot better. It’s a bit out of my way but I’m more than happy to go for the quality of service.
